QUADRO-CHAVE — O Último Farol · Ep. 1 · Plano 3. Gere UMA imagem vertical 9:16 (1080×1920) que será o PRIMEIRO QUADRO do vídeo deste plano.

## PLANO
- Plano 3 · video_ia · 8 s · local: sala
- Prompt do plano (inglês): Camera: Medium shot from the side at eye level, slow push-in. Subject: Mara, a woman in her early 30s, dark hair tied back in a low bun, dark waterproof work jacket with a reflective strip, tired but firm face, seen in profile, mouth closed. Action: she turns the dial of the grey marine VHF radio and freezes, listening; through the large window behind her, city districts go dark one block at a time. Context: lighthouse control room at night, old green metal control panel, large window facing the sea and the distant city, cold light. Style: cinematic and realistic, muted teal and amber palette, quiet suspense, vertical 9:16, no on-screen text, no blood.
- O que acontece (pt-BR): Mara de perfil no painel gira o botão do rádio e congela, ouvindo; pela janela, bairros da cidade apagam um a um.
- Falas fora de quadro (alerta por radio): ninguém com a boca aberta falando.
